subject.title: fix(xai): bound stalled generated video download body reads

question: Should xAI downloads use a distinct body-idle budget shorter than the total guarded request deadline, or should they expose only the existing generic total timeout?
rationale: The current single timeout value cannot reliably provide both error semantics, and selecting a shorter idle threshold or a broader shared transport contract changes provider timeout policy beyond a mechanical wiring fix.

options.title: Separate idle and total deadlines
options.body: Keep the existing total request deadline and add a clearly defined shorter body-idle threshold that can produce the xAI-specific stalled-download error.

options.title: Keep only the total deadline
options.body: Remove the ineffective idle-error claim and rely on the existing guarded request timeout if a distinct stall diagnosis is not worth another policy value.

options.title: Create a shared download policy
options.body: Define separate total and idle deadlines in a shared provider download helper and migrate affected video providers together to avoid repeated inconsistent wiring.

recommendation.title: Separate idle and total deadlines
recommendation.body: Keep the existing total request deadline and add a clearly defined shorter body-idle threshold that can produce the xAI-specific stalled-download error.

likelyOwner.reason: The history connects this person to both the original video-generation surface and the merged xAI provider-timeout policy.
